answer: The anchor counter is kept in basalt and bridge makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1351 identities would post 939 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
